text: I started a ₹2,000 SIP six months ago as a first-time investor. It is slightly negative now and I am worried I made a mistake. I keep checking the app and watching YouTube videos about whether I should stop.
My SIP mandate failed last month and I did not realise until later. I paused the SIP because I was not sure whether it would keep failing.
Salary was delayed and I had a medical expense, so I paused my SIP. I plan to resume next month but I am not sure how pausing works.
I began investing after seeing friends post returns. After three months my SIP looked flat and I felt confused about whether I should continue or cancel.
First-time investor here. My SIP is in loss and I am anxious. I searched Reddit and asked my brother whether I should stop investing.
I want to reduce my monthly SIP because of a tight month, but I am afraid that pausing will spoil my investment.
